description: This file defines the class `fogbugzdbInterface`, which provides an interface between a test management system (TestLink) and the FogBugz bug tracking system's database. It includes methods for constructing bug view URLs, retrieving bug details, checking bug existence and syntax, and generating HTML strings for bug statuses. The class extends `issueTrackerInterface`, indicating it implements specific bug tracking functionalities specialized for FogBugz.

classes.name: fogbugzdbInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with the FogBugz bug tracking system database, providing functions to retrieve bug details, generate URLs, verify bug existence, and produce status-related HTML snippets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface and connects to the database, setting configuration options.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL to view a specific bug by its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches bug details from the database for a given bug ID and returns an object with bug properties.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of a bug based on its ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the specified ID exists in the database.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML link for viewing the bug, styled according to its status.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the format of a bug ID.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Generates an HTML string summarizing the bug's status, possibly with strike-through for closed bugs.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface type used by this class.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template XML configuration for setting up the bug tracker interface.
